text:
sam_c: Planning a coordinated rollout tonight 02:10-02:40 UTC. Order: api -> runtime -> console -> router. Main risk is runtime->router header compatibility. Call blockers now.

mona: API sha-api-11 ready. No migrations. Canary green on eu-staging.

frank: Runtime will send X-Runtime-Flag:quant; routers <v18 reject. Options: update router whitelist first or start runtime in compat mode. We have compat binary sha-rt-3.6.1c.

ui-lead: Console has a copy tweak only. We'll disable FEATURE_BETA for canary and mute UI telemetry.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled wave 02:15 UTC. Sequence api=sha-api-11,runtime=sha-rt-361q,console=sha-ui-45,router=sha-router-18. Canary: eu-only 1% for 12m then 10% for 6m. Prewarm probe after api canary for 4m. Auto-rollback enabled.

sam_c: Ops asks: scope initial canary to router-standby pool and add a post-reload probe confirming 200 on header-accept endpoint. If whitelist not present within 7m after router reload, fallback = pin runtime to compat sha-rt-3.6.1c and abort router change.

frank: Affirmative. I'll try the router reload but will be ready to flip RUNTIME_COMPAT and coordinate pin with deploybot.

sre-bot: Staging smoke: 11/11 checks OK. p99 api 105ms, p99 runtime 170ms. Dashboards & alert links posted.

sam_c: Rollback triggers (short): error rate >0.9% sustained 3m OR p99 >1.8s for 3m OR prewarm failures. To trigger immediate rollback reply exactly "rollback" in this thread. deploybot will execute rollback-run.

mona: I'll watch api traces and confirm canary start.

frank: I'll tail runtime and router-standby logs; will call "hold" in-thread if whitelist lagging.

deploybot: deploybot: standing by. Will emit events to #release-notifications when wave starts.
